messages.subject: GCC Infrastructure Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Myra,

Menasa & Partners' executive-search work across major UAE and Saudi infrastructure programmes is relevant to my background in regulated, stakeholder-intensive environments. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where infrastructure delivery depends on public-sector engagement, regulatory credibility and responsible development. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
